== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Alchemists are members of a highly influential, wealthy, and well-connected organization known as the [[Alchemist's Guild|Guild of Alchemists]]. They are recognized by a standard uniform consisting of stained aprons—often featuring a [[gold crown symbol]]—bulging glass goggles, and gloves. While some practitioners work in specialized environments like warehouses or laboratories, others may be found in various settings across the world. [[The Guild]] is known to have members accepted almost everywhere, allowing for significant information gathering regarding other guilds. The profession encompasses a wide range of specializations, including medical alchemy, organ processing and storage, and the manufacturing of explosives. Their work involves the creation and administration of diverse substances such as potions, pills, solutions, gases, and creams. These can be used for healing, enhancing physical attributes like strength and reaction time, or as tools for combat and restraint, such as paralytics, hallucinogens, and adhesives. Some alchemists also utilize specialized weaponry, including modified pistols with integrated smoking bottles. Beyond medicine and combat, alchemy involves complex research that can lead to permanent physical modifications through long-term potion use. [[The Guild]] is powerful enough to mobilize various laborers for large-[[scale]] movements and can receive direct assignments from the Emperor. While many alchemists are dedicated to their craft, the [[Guild]] has also faced scrutiny regarding its ethics, such as the exhumation of bodies for research or the high markups placed on their products.}}
